rule: Owner, 2026-10-25: a character who appears once looks the same in every later video (Moses after 100 videos is the same Moses). Every prompt that shows a character carries its `look` word for word (plus one `wardrobe` variant), Agnes clips pass its approved reference images (reference mode, up to 5), and FLUX stills reuse its seed. A character is used only when its status is APPROVED (Claude reviewed the reference sheet). God the Father is never shown as a person: light, wind, voice (reverence; the KJV text carries Him).

noah.name: Noah
noah.look: a strong broad-shouldered elderly man of about seventy with Middle Eastern features, weathered olive skin, a long grey beard, short grey hair on a bare head, deep-set dark eyes under heavy brows, a plain brown wool robe belted with a rope

noah.note: Genesis 7:6 makes him six hundred years old at the flood; shown as a strong elderly man of about seventy (owner, 2026-10-26). A bare head, a grey (not silver-white) beard and a belted plain robe keep him apart from the Keeper's hood and silver beard.

scoffer.name: The scoffer
scoffer.look: a lean hawk-faced man of about forty-five with Middle Eastern features, sun-darkened olive skin, a sharp hooked nose, narrow dark eyes under thin arched brows, a black beard trimmed short to a point, black hair oiled back under a red-and-black striped headcloth, a long plain crimson wool tunic tied with a broad black sash

wardrobe.valley: standing at the front of a jeering crowd in a dry valley, one arm flung toward a vast wooden hull
wardrobe.torches: holding a burning torch high at night, the firelight on his face

scoffer.role: antagonist only: an invented ringleader of the valley's mockers in the days of Noah, never a named biblical person; his lines are our own words, never Scripture
scoffer.note: Genesis records no word of the mockers: the scoffer's taunts are dramatization (kind story, no reference). The crimson tunic, striped headcloth and pointed black beard keep him apart from Noah's plain belted robe and grey beard and the Keeper's hood and silver beard.
